To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reaction of α, ω-diacetylenic compounds with N-alkoxy-substituted 2-oxazolines and N-alkyl-1,5, 3-dioxazolones in the presence of catalytic amounts of copper-containing complexes leads to the corresponding azacyclodiynyl derivatives.
the reaction of α, ω-diacetylenic diols with 1,2,4-triazole and copper(I) iodide as catalysts gives azacyclodiynyl triazoles in high yields.
the reaction of N-alkyl-1,5,2-dioxazepan-3-amines with α,ω-diyne in the presence of a Cu(I) salt and a base gives the corresponding azacyclodiyne derivatives in good to excellent yields.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the one-pot synthesis of cyclic prop-argylamines by the reaction of α, ω-diacetylenic substrates with N-alky-substituted 3,5-dihydro-1,5,2-dioxazepines in the presence of catalytic amounts of copper-containing catalyst.
the development of efficient and practical methods for the synthesis of heterocyclic systems.
the development of a novel method for the synthesis of azacyclopropargylamines by the one-pot reaction of α, ω-diacetylenic compounds and N-alkyl-1,5, 3-dioxazolanes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reaction of α, ω-diacetylenic compounds with 1, 5, 3-dioxazolanes in the presence copper-containing catalysts is the most convenient and effective way to obtain azacyclodiyne compounds.
the synthesis of cyclic diynes is a simple one-pot process, which is a significant advantage of the developed method.

the synthesis of azacycloalkynes is a very efficient process, which is not only of synthetic value but also provides a new method for the synthesis of a wide variety of heterocyclic compounds, including those that are not easily accessible by other methods.

aminomethylenation of α,ω-alkadiynes with 1,3-dicarbonyl compounds in the presence of Cu(I) catalysts leads to a new method of synthesis of 1-aza-cycloalkadiynes, and this method is more effective and selective than the previous one.

the reaction of 1,5-diketones, α,ω-dicarboxylic acids, and α,ω-diesters with hydrazine hydrate in the presence of a copper-containing catalyst in a one-pot procedure leads to the formation of 1,2,3-oxadiazoles and/or 1,3,4-oxadiazolines in moderate to excellent yields.
